index_line: - [[polk-audio-signature-elite-es20]] — 8 Ω compatible (measured min 3.6 Ω), LW ±2.2 dB, f3 53 Hz, pref 4.5 (ASR)
source_index_lines: - [[mfr-polk-audio-signature-elite-es20]] — Polk product page and info sheet (Tier C)
brand_notes: Polk US lists all bookshelf models current (Reserve R100/R200, Signature Elite ES15/ES20, T15, Monitor XT15/XT20). Nominal impedance is not stated for ES/XT/Reserve ('compatible with 4- and 8-ohm outputs'); only T-Series info sheet rates T15 at 8 ohm. Measured minima for ES20 3.6, XT15/XT20 about 4.0, T15 about 4.1 ohm: all effectively 4 ohm designs. Design traits: Terylene dome tweeters, Dynamic Balance cones, budget price, 5-year warranty, Vietnam manufacture (tnt-audio XT15).
takeaways: Polk gives only '4- and 8-ohm compatible'; measured min 3.6 Ω so effectively-4ohm flag
LW ±2.2 dB, f3 53 Hz, wide 143° horizontal beamwidth, but 600-1000 Hz port/cabinet resonances
THD ~0.7% at 86 dB above 100 Hz; clean
Only ASR (Tier A) data; no other professional review found
conflicts: Sensitivity 87.2 computed vs 86 claimed (88 dB/1 W retailers)
ERDI major-discontinuity vs ASR 'smooth' horizontal beamwidth
log_bullets: Impedance flag effectively-4ohm from ASR min 3.6 Ω (graph-read); nominal recorded as 8 Ω compatible per scope rule
Conflict: sensitivity/directivity wording noted in speaker page
